title: Inlet Air Pressure Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki dash code 11 indicates inlet air pressure (MAP) sensor signal out of range.

faq.a: Mounted on airbox or throttle body.

title: Inlet Air Temperature Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki IAT sensor in airbox circuit fault. Default values used.

title: Atmospheric Pressure Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki ECU baro sensor reading out of range. Often resolves on key cycle.

fixSteps.title: Dealer check
fixSteps.instruction: ECU update or replacement at dealer.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki ECT signal out of range. Affects fuel and fan logic.

title: Throttle Position Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki TPS fault. Throttle response affected.

fixSteps.title: Reset TPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use Kawasaki KDS to reset TPS baseline.

faq.a: Aftermarket clones work for many models.

title: Tip-Over Sensor (Bank Angle)
shortDescription: Bank angle sensor activation or fault.
fullDescription: Kawasaki BAS triggered after fall or has electrical fault.

fixSteps.title: Cycle key
fixSteps.instruction: Set bike upright and cycle ignition.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki CKP signal lost; engine no-start or stall.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Locate CKP, check tip for debris.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor
fullDescription: Kawasaki speedometer or ECU lost VSS signal. ABS/TC may also alert.

title: Stick Coil 1 Fault
fullDescription: Kawasaki ECU detects cyl 1 stick coil fault. Misfire on that cylinder.

title: Sub-Throttle Valve Actuator
fullDescription: Kawasaki sub-throttle stepper or position sensor fault.
